overview.match: Jeffery W. Johnson is a director
overview.text: Jeffery W. Johnson is a director on the Crescenta Valley Water District board. He is an attorney and manages the law firm Johnson & Rawi PC. In 2025, he praised the district's management for addressing reduced water supply, aging pipelines, PFAS contamination, and tap water taste and hardness. In 2025, as board president, he spoke at a public meeting about proposed water and wastewater rate increases. In 2026, he moved to approve revisions to the district’s Bill Assistance Program.
